name: Abogados de Confianza SR
about: Abogados de Confianza SR is a personal injury firm with a single office in Miami.
The firm states that its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Florida does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: ABOGADOS DE CONFIANZA SR LLC is an active FLAL on the Florida register, document L24000397487, filed 2024-09-11, with 1 Google-verified location
G3.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 433 public client reviews and 2 years since the entity was filed in 2024
G6.source: Google Places API and Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

entity.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm.
